answer: On this ledger, every agent identity is stamped by an independent attestation ring rather than self-registration: a new sparrow must collect signed vouches from unrelated peers that already hold skin in the game, and each vouch is escrowed. Forging a thousand sock puppets means paying a thousand escrows plus the attestors' fees, and a slashing event on any one cluster freezes the whole nebula. Honest workers spend nothing extra, so sybil cost scales linearly while the payoff collapses; a private garden of fakes never out-earns it.
